description: This file implements game status management for the Battle for Wesnoth game, including classes and functions for handling game time, player info, game state, save/load functionality, and game configuration serialization.

classes.name: time_of_day
classes.description: Represents a time of day with associated visual and color properties.

classes.name: gamestatus
classes.description: Manages game time, areas, and turns.

classes.name: game_state
classes.description: Represents the overall game state, including players, variables, and save/load functionality.

methods.name: get_player
methods.description: Retrieves a pointer to player_info by player ID.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Serializes time_of_day data into a config object.

methods.name: parse_times
methods.description: Parses time and illuminated_time entries from config into vectors.

methods.name: gamestatus
methods.description: Constructor initializing game status with configuration and number of turns.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Serializes gamestatus data into a config object.

methods.name: get_time_of_day_turn
methods.description: Returns the time_of_day for a specific turn.

methods.name: get_time_of_day
methods.description: Returns the current time_of_day.

methods.name: get_previous_time_of_day
methods.description: Returns the previous turn's time_of_day.

methods.name: get_time_of_day
methods.description: Returns time_of_day for a specific location and illumination status.

methods.name: turn
methods.description: Returns the current turn number.

methods.name: number_of_turns
methods.description: Returns total number of turns.

methods.name: next_turn
methods.description: Advances to the next turn.

methods.name: read_player
methods.description: Reads player info from config.

methods.name: read_game
methods.description: Reads game state from config.

methods.name: write_player
methods.description: Serializes player info into config.

methods.name: write_game
methods.description: Serializes game state into config.

methods.name: get_saves_list
methods.description: Returns a list of saved games.

methods.name: save_game_exists
methods.description: Checks if a save game exists.

methods.name: delete_game
methods.description: Deletes a saved game.

methods.name: read_save_file
methods.description: Reads save file into config.

methods.name: load_game
methods.description: Loads game state from save file.

methods.name: save_game
methods.description: Saves current game state to file.

methods.name: save_index
methods.description: Returns the save index configuration.

methods.name: save_summary
methods.description: Returns or creates a save summary config.

methods.name: delete_save_summary
methods.description: Deletes a save summary.

methods.name: write_save_index
methods.description: Writes the save index to disk.

methods.name: extract_summary_data_from_save
methods.description: Extracts summary data from game state for save listing.

methods.name: get_variable_internal
methods.description: Retrieves a variable from game variables, supporting nested and array syntax.

methods.name: get_variable
methods.description: Returns a variable value as string.

methods.name: get_variable_const
methods.description: Returns a variable value as const string reference.

methods.name: get_variable_cfg
methods.description: Returns a variable as config object.

methods.name: set_variable
methods.description: Sets a variable in game variables.
